## BuildConfigurations.\_namesSet property

Set of all build configuration names for duplicate detection.

**Signature:**

```typescript
protected readonly _namesSet: Set<string>;
```

## Remarks

This set provides O(1) existence checks for configuration names, enabling efficient validation during template expansion to prevent duplicate configurations.

Duplicate scenarios detected:

<ol> <li>Explicit duplicates in <code>package.json</code> with identical names.</li> <li>Template expansion conflicts where different templates generate the same concrete configuration name.</li> <li>Conflicts between template-generated names and explicitly defined configuration names.</li> </ol>

Detection occurs during [BuildConfigurations.initialise()](./xpm-lib.buildconfigurations.initialise.md)<!-- -->, throwing [ConfigurationError](./xpm-lib.configurationerror.md) when duplicates are found to ensure configuration name uniqueness.
